name: Kate Juenger
headline: Shaping the future of digital health care | Host of the Podcast “The Connected Physician”
location: San Francisco, United States of America
summary:
I am a serial health tech entrepreneur with a single mission: Providing patients with better access to care with the help of technology. 

I am currently building Cade Partners out of San Francisco, a healthcare services investment firm focused on tech enablement. 

I am also the host of the "The Connected Physician" where I interview inspiring physicians across the US.

Previously, I was the Founder and CEO of TeleClinic, Germany's No1 platform for online doctor visits, serving millions of patients with digital prescriptions and sick-notes. 
I successfully sold TeleClinic to DocMorris, Europe's leading online pharmacy.

positions.title: Co-Founder & CEO
positions.description: TeleClinic is the No1 platform for online doctor visits including digital prescriptions and sick-notes in Germany. It was acquired by the Zur Rose Group, listed at the Swiss stock exchange. Together, TeleClinic and the Zur Rose Group now pursue the vision of building Europe's leading platform from diagnosis to delivery.

positions.title: English teacher and social support assistant
positions.company: Centro Juvenil de Diagnostico y Rehabilitación Marcavalle, Cusco, Peru
positions.description: Teaching juvenile offenders English and social skills was a formative experience for me. It aligned with my preparation for law studies and was deeply influenced by my father, a psychiatrist who treated patients in prison. Inspired by his work, I sought to understand the root causes of criminal behavior, the extent to which it is shaped by social environments, and whether incarceration can positively influence future behavior.

company.tagline: Cade Partners is a healthcare services buyout firm that drives value through tech enablement and operational improvement
company.description:
Cade Partners is a healthcare services buyout firm transforming traditional healthcare and life sciences businesses through technology and operational excellence.

We make majority investments in profitable, founder-led companies with $2-15M EBITDA and combine deep healthcare expertise, entrepreneurial experience, and modern automation tools - particularly AI - to unlock margin expansion, improve workflows, and drive sustainable growth.

As an AI-native firm, we believe in a future where humans and AI work hand in hand - creating better workplaces and expanding access to quality care.

If you are an entrepreneur who wants to work with us or if you are interested to join our team, send us a message at katharina@cadepartners.com
